test_definition.name: Household clothing: put on coat
test_definition.description: Third real general state-update benchmark and mirror of test 002. The conversation names a brown leather coat before Evan puts it on; the only justified tracked change is appending that item to his clothing list.

provenance.note: All people, employers, household details, and events are fictional benchmark data.

source.new_information: It is a weekday morning and Evan Harper is getting ready to leave for work while talking with Laura near the entryway. Evan looks at the coat rack, where his brown leather coat is hanging. Laura says, "It looks colder than yesterday." Evan tells her he should still be home around 5:30, and they talk for another moment about dinner. Before leaving, Evan takes the coat from the rack and puts it on over his shirt. He walks out through the front door, locks it behind him with his house key, and heads to work, still carrying his wallet, house keys, and phone.
